name: Farmer Pension Scheme
benefit: A pension of ₹1,200/- per month is provided to eligible farmers.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer actively engaged in cultivating their own land. 1. The applicant must be above 60 years of age. 1. The applicant must own and cultivate up to 2 hectares of agricultural land.
